scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello! I recently submitted a housing loan application and I'm inquiring about the status and details of my application. Can you please tell me what the current status of my application is? Has it been approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application, LOAN-00083, has been originated, which means it has been approved and the loan has been processed.

dialogue.user: I'm glad to hear that my application has been approved. Can you please tell me what my interest rate is and what are the total costs of this loan? I'm trying to understand the overall terms of the loan.
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.062% and the total loan costs are $3,602.48.

dialogue.user: I've taken note of my interest rate and total loan costs. What type of loan product was I approved for, and are there any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan that I should be aware of?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is a Conventional: First Lien loan product. It is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: I'm glad to hear that my loan doesn't have any high-cost or negative amortization features. Has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution, and can you tell me what my loan term is? I want to make sure I understand all the details of my loan.
dialogue.agent: The purchaser type for your loan is not applicable, as it was not sold to another institution after origination. Your loan term is 360 months.

dialogue.user: I've got all the information I need. I'd like to rate this interaction. I would say I'm <Satisfied> because the agent was clear, honest, and provided all the information I requested in a straightforward manner.
